errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category with the given id or name is not found in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product with the given id is not found in the database.

errors.name: SkuAlreadyExistsError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to add a product with a sku that already exists.

errors.name: InvalidSkuError
errors.description: Raised when the sku is not a valid string.

errors.name: InvalidStockQtyError
errors.description: Raised when stock_qty is negative or zero.
